CLEAR BY DESIGN

What stays here.
What goes out.

A good companion makes the boundaries clear.

01 /

Listen on your Mac.

Speech is transcribed on your Mac by default. Raw audio is not saved; transcripts and notes are.

02 /

Share relevant context.

Answers use the material relevant to the current question, rather than your entire document collection.

03 /

Choose who processes it.

Text needed for answers and notes goes to the service you choose. Web search and the phone companion are off by default.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we begin.

A little context before your next conversation.

Can I download it now?+

InterviewHacker 2.0 is not publicly available yet. Join the waitlist and we'll email you when access opens. The interactions on this page are illustrative demos, not a live desktop app.

Which devices and meetings does it support?+

The desktop app is for Mac. Online meetings use computer audio and the microphone separately. In-person meetings use the microphone, with speech labeled “Room.” The phone companion opens in a browser. System requirements will be included with your invitation.

Can I use it just for notes?+

Yes. Switch to notes-only mode to keep the transcript without answer suggestions. When the meeting ends, it becomes structured notes. Try the switch in the demo above.

Can other people see my prompts?+

Visibility depends on what you share. Prompts on your computer may be visible during full-screen sharing; you can move them to an unshared phone. There is no claim of invisibility or undetectability. Obtain consent and follow the rules of the setting.

Can I rely on the answers and notes?+

They are suggestions to help you think. Check important facts against the materials and original discussion, especially numbers, decisions and action items. Sources and “to confirm” labels give you a place to start.
